# <zbk-code-block>

A labelled source listing with optional trusted HTML preview and an
accessible, resizable split view.

Base class: `.zbk-code-block`. Variant classes: `.zbk-code-block--{variant}`. Tokens: `--zbk-code-block-{property}[-{state}]`. Write `aria-*`/`role` on the element; they relocate to the internal native element. `focus()` forwards to the internal focusable.

## When to use

- A code sample needs a visible label and a consistent copy affordance.
- One trusted HTML source should also serve as a rendered example without duplicating markup.
- An authored framework or initialized example needs a synchronized source and preview container.
- NOT A short identifier or expression belongs inside prose. → Use the native <code> element without a block component.
- NOT Untrusted source must be sanitized or isolated before rendering. → Sanitize or sandbox it outside Zebkit; automatic preview is an explicit trusted-HTML boundary.
- NOT Scripts or framework source must be compiled and executed in the browser. → Supply initialized output through slot="preview"; this component never resurrects scripts or bundles a runtime compiler.

## Guidance

- Author one direct <pre><code> tree for the strongest no-JavaScript fallback. One direct <code> is also accepted and is normalized after upgrade unless normalizeCode is disabled.
- Automatic preview parses code.textContent as trusted light-DOM HTML. Only enable it for source the application already trusts.
- Use slot="preview" for Svelte, TypeScript, initialized widgets, or any rendering that is not a static HTML fragment; authored preview always wins.
- Preview is off by default. view="preview", split="on", or show-preview="on" opts one instance in; project configuration can set each reusable default.
- Code and Preview use the shared Tabs contract and a real tablist. Use tabs-variant for their registered Tabs treatment; the configured default is compact.
- Copy is a real zbk-button using button-variant. Split is a separate display preference rendered as zbk-toggle by default; toggle-variant styles it, split-control="checkbox" selects zbk-checkbox with checkbox-variant, and split-control="off" removes the control.
- While Split is on, activating Code allocates 80% to source and activating Preview allocates 80% to preview. The separator remains available for finer 5% adjustments.
- The copy action always copies original source text, including when only Preview is visible.
- Source and long preview text wrap by default. Use code-wrap="off" or preview-wrap="off" only when horizontal scrolling better preserves the example.

## Slots

| Slot | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *(default)* | One direct semantic <pre><code> tree, or one direct <code> normalized after upgrade. Highlighting classes and descendant spans are preserved. | — |
| `preview` | An authored rendering that overrides automatic HTML preview. Use it for framework components, initialized widgets, or other non-static output. | — |
| `action` | A supplementary top-bar button or link. Repeat the slot for multiple actions; authored order is preserved before the built-in copy action. | — |
| `icon` | A per-instance decorative pictogram for the resting Copy action. It overrides components.code-block.options.copyIcon and is replaced by the configured success icon after copying. | aria-hidden |

- `preview`: Keep any scripting or initialization in application code; the component only adopts the rendered nodes.
- `preview`: The preview remains interactive and exposed to assistive technology whenever its pane is visible.
- `icon`: Use the shared icon slot for one-off markup; use copyIcon configuration to set the project-wide default. Button owns its rendered size and states.
- `icon`: The icon is aria-hidden and reinforces the visible Copy label; it never supplies the accessible name.

## Keyboard

- `Left/Right on a tab` — Moves selection and focus between Code and Preview with wrapping roving focus; while Split is on, the selected pane receives 80% of the inline space.
- `Home/End on a tab` — Selects and focuses Code or Preview respectively.
- `Space on the Split preference` — Uses the native zbk-toggle or zbk-checkbox interaction to show or hide the second pane.
- `Left/Right on the split separator` — Changes the code share by five percentage points; logical direction reverses under RTL.
- `Home/End on the split separator` — Sets the code share to its 20% minimum or 80% maximum.

Precedence is one chain with no exceptions: **instance attribute > project config > zebkit default** — whatever the config decided, the markup outranks it.

| `label` | `string` | `"Code"` | The fallback visible caption when an instance does not provide a more specific language or filename label. |
| `copy` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the built-in Copy action is rendered when an instance does not set copy. |
| `copyIcon` | `object` | `{"html":"<svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\"><rect x=\"9\" y=\"9\" width=\"13\" height=\"13\" rx=\"2\"></rect><path d=\"M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1\"></path></svg>"}` | The decorative icon beside Copy: { text }, { classes }, { src }, or { html } follows the shared icon option shape, while false removes it. |
| `copiedIcon` | `object` | `{"html":"<svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\"><path d=\"m5 12 4 4L19 6\"></path></svg>"}` | The decorative success icon beside Copied: { text }, { classes }, { src }, or { html } follows the shared icon option shape, while false removes it. |
| `showPreview` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether trusted source HTML gets an automatic preview when neither show-preview nor an explicit preview-capable view decides the instance. |
| `view` | `string` | `"code"` | The initially selected Code or Preview tab when an instance does not set view. |
| `split` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether both panes are initially visible when an instance does not set split. |
| `splitControl` | `string` | `"toggle"` | Whether the built-in Split preference uses zbk-toggle, zbk-checkbox, or is disabled with false when an instance does not set split-control. |
| `tabsVariant` | `string` | `"compact"` | Tabs variants passed to the Code and Preview tablist when an instance omits tabs-variant; false passes none. |
| `buttonVariant` | `string` | `"toolbar sm flat"` | Button variants passed to the built-in Copy action when an instance omits button-variant; false passes none. |
| `toggleVariant` | `string` | `false` | Toggle variants passed to the Split control when an instance omits toggle-variant; false passes none. |
| `checkboxVariant` | `string` | `false` | Checkbox variants passed to the Split control when an instance omits checkbox-variant; false passes none. |

| `previewWrap` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether long preview text and preformatted content wrap when an instance does not set preview-wrap. |

## Conditions

Conditions are compiled layout branches, not element states. Their suffixed tokens are read only inside the matching at-rule.

| Condition | Kind | Threshold | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wide` | container | `container.sm` | Split view places source at logical inline-start and preview at inline-end at or above this code-block width; narrower blocks stack source first. |

## Events

- `zbk-view-change` — A user selected the Code or Preview tab.
- `zbk-split-change` — A user resized the split with a tab, pointer, or keyboard.

## Examples

**Copyable TypeScript**

```html
<zbk-code-block label="TypeScript"><pre><code>const ready = true;</code></pre></zbk-code-block>
```

The default remains a readable code-only listing and copies the source exactly.

**Single-source HTML preview**

```html
<zbk-code-block label="HTML" split="on"><pre><code>&lt;button type="button"&gt;Save&lt;/button&gt;</code></pre></zbk-code-block>
```

The explicit Split state opts trusted HTML into automatic rendering without duplicating the button markup.

**Authored preview**

```html
<zbk-code-block label="Svelte" show-preview="on"><pre><code>&lt;Counter /&gt;</code></pre><div slot="preview"><button type="button">Count: 0</button></div></zbk-code-block>
```

The preview slot is the supported rendering boundary for framework-owned output and makes both tabs plus Split available.

**Direct code normalization**

```html
<zbk-code-block label="Shell"><code>npm test</code></zbk-code-block>
```

The default normalizeCode option removes repetitive pre markup while preserving one source node.

## Variants

A variant is a named, partial remapping of the token surface compiled to a class. Apply via `variant="name other-name"`; different axes compose, same-axis variants are alternatives.

| Variant | Axis | Class | Description | Overrides |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aaa` | accessibility | `zbk-code-block--aaa` | AAA code and chrome contrast, larger reading type, and full-size action targets. | ink: {app.ink-emphasis}; border-color: {app.ink-emphasis}; bar-ink: {app.ink-emphasis}; bar-border-color: {app.ink-emphasis}; bar-font-size: {font-size.sm}; bar-padding-inline: {spacing.md}; bar-padding-block: {spacing.sm}; bar-gap: {spacing.md}; actions-gap: {spacing.sm}; view-gap: {spacing.sm}; code-ink: {app.ink-emphasis}; code-font-size: {font-size.md}; code-padding-inline: {spacing.lg}; code-padding-block: {spacing.lg}; preview-ink: {app.ink-emphasis}; preview-padding-inline: {spacing.lg}; preview-padding-block: {spacing.lg}; split-divider-ink: {app.ink-emphasis}; split-divider-ink-hover: {app.ink-emphasis}; split-divider-ink-active: {info.ink}; split-divider-target-size: {spacing.xl}; split-grip-canvas: {app.canvas}; split-grip-ink: {app.ink-emphasis}; split-grip-border-color: {app.ink-emphasis}; focus-color: {info.ink} |

Custom variants: add a `zbk-code-block.variants.json` file to the base theme's token folder (component-keyed map of `{ "code-block": { "{name}": { "overrides": { ... } } } }`; token keys must exist in the table above, values are alias references or structural literals). A shipped variant name patches that variant's CSS — usable immediately. A new name compiles a new `.zbk-code-block--{name}` class and additionally needs `ZebkitElement.registerVariants(json)` before elements upgrade so `variant="{name}"` validates and applies it.

Related: `<zbk-button>`, `<zbk-checkbox>`, `<zbk-link>`, `<zbk-tabs>`, `<zbk-toggle>`.
